````markdown
# Plan (opus, strong)

## Goal

The opponent's imagined reply (`simulate_reply_with`, `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`) must keep steps for its attacks and always end its turn:

- Known plays and visible Activates together take at most a new `AI_REPLY.play_steps` (6) of the reply's `AI_REPLY.max_steps` (12) steps.
- When the 12 steps run out with the opponent still on turn, the reply ends that turn in up to a new `AI_REPLY.close_steps` (3) more steps, so the line is scored at the AI's next decision.
- Ruling R4810000 records this decision.
- Tests prove it on a pinned board (a test-only free unlimited Activate) and on the issue's Miner v5 board.
- The PR records an improve-dev screen.

**Planner's check:** I applied exactly this change to a scratch copy of `crates/` outside the worktree:
- With the change, the three tests below pass.
- On `main` all three fail. The Miner test fails with the issue's message, "active P2, turn 10, the AI at 2".
- With the change, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --lib --test ai --test ai_slow` passed, and so did the server's `r1303002` practice-claim fold.

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `AiReply`: the `max_steps` doc, new fields `play_steps: i32` and `close_steps: i32`. `AI_REPLY`: `play_steps: 6`, `close_steps: 3` and their comments |
| `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` | change | module header, `simulate_reply` doc, the `simulate_reply_with` loop |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/reply.rs` | change | new `mod step_caps_r4810000` at the end of the file |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | one clause in the reply parenthetical |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.9 "The opponent's reply": one sentence |
| `spec/rulings/R4810000.md` | new | the ruling |
| `spec/pending/4810.md` | new | its §11 paragraph |
| `docs/polish/3-ai.md` | change | the "At most `AI_REPLY.maxSteps` steps" sentence |
| `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json` | change only if its test asks | re-recorded (Step 10) |

Do not touch:
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`.
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`.

- SPEC §9.9, "The opponent's reply": the opponent "answers the line by a fixed rule and ends its turn, and the line is scored at the start of the AI's next turn".
- Rulings R384, R1872000 (S #66), R4515000 (the reply's order), R4433000 and R4319000.

     /// Engine steps one reply's turn may take: plays, Activates, switches, attacks, prompt answers and
     /// its own endTurn. R4810000: a turn whose steps run out with the opponent still on turn is ended
     /// in up to `close_steps` more.
     ```

     /// R4810000: the most of `max_steps` that known plays (reply.rs `known_play`) and visible
     /// Activates (`visible_activation`) take together. Past it a step tries neither, so a card with

     /// the attacks the rest.
````
